description: Pinned YARA rule text for the malware engine (docs/design/malware-engine-v1.md §3.3, §3.7). Rule text only; fetched and verified by data/scripts/fetch_yara.py.
pin_reason: Newest signature-base commit at least two weeks old on 2026-11-25 (committed 2026-11-06). Rule text only; owner approved this download on 2026-11-25.

census.parser: Rules and meta key/value pairs are read by data/scripts/fetch_yara.py parse_rules() without compiling. Licence statements come from each rule's license meta values and from comments. A comment covers: every rule in the file if it ends before the first rule (file header); the rule it sits inside; or the rule it sits just above (only whitespace or other comments between them). Comment lines or blocks separated only by whitespace form one comment, except that a comment containing a rule declaration is never merged. Comments that contain a rule declaration (commented-out rules) are not licence statements and stop the "just above" walk. In a comment, a "License: X" / "license = X" line is classified like a meta value, and free text is matched for NC, GNU GPL, BSD, Apache-2.0, MIT and DRL 1.1 wording; a comment that mentions a licence but matches nothing is unclear. Values are classified in this order: non_commercial (by-nc, NC, non-commercial), copyleft (GPL family), drl_1_1 (DRL 1.1 named with its version), other_permissive (MIT, BSD, Apache, CC BY, UK Open Government Licence), otherwise unclear (for example a bare link to a licence file, or DRL without a version). A rule with no statement is drl_1_1 by default; one class is that class; two or more classes are unclear (conflict).
